Name: Event Pace - Immersive Heart Event and Cutscene Control
Author: AnnaCharles
Description:
[center][size=6]Event Pace[/size][/center]
[center][i]Experience Stardew Valley's stories at your own pace.[/i][/center]
[center][i]Some stories are worth waiting for. Now you can choose when the moment feels right.[/i][/center]

[center]Ever walked into town to do something simple, only to suddenly find yourself in the middle of an unexpected event?[/center]
[center]Sometimes you're ready for a heartfelt conversation. Sometimes you're just trying to get to Pierre's before he closes.[/center]
[center]Event Pace lets you decide.[/center]

[center]When a compatible event is about to begin, Event Pace gives you the choice to experience it now or save it for another day.[/center]
[center]It doesn't rewrite the story, change the dialogue or permanently skip the event.[/center]
[center]The story stays the same. You simply choose when you're ready to experience it.[/center]
[center]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b]A little support goes a long way.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Endorsements, comments, and feedback help these mods grow and inspire what comes next.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Thanks for being part of it.[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]


[b]🌟 Story Sense — A Little Sparkle of Discovery[/b]
Your farmer can now get a little hint when there's a story waiting nearby.
A small golden sparkle appears beside your farmer's head when Event Pace detects a potential eligible event.
It's a gentle reminder that something special might be waiting around the corner.
• A subtle golden sparkle near your farmer's head.
• An adjacent number when multiple eligible events can be identified.
• Naturally follows your farmer as they move.
• Designed to stay out of the way of everyday gameplay.
• Helps you notice story opportunities without immediately interrupting your day.
Sometimes the sparkle appears without a number when an event's eligibility depends on conditions that can't be safely confirmed ahead of time.
It's a little hint, not a spoiler.

[b]💞 Your Story, Your Timing[/b]
Stardew Valley is full of wonderful heart events and memorable character moments.
But sometimes they happen when you're not quite ready.
Maybe you're rushing to finish your farm chores.
Maybe you're carrying a full inventory.
Or maybe you're simply not in the mood for an emotional conversation right now.
When Event Pace detects a compatible optional event, it gives you a choice before the event begins.
Experience the event now, or postpone it for today.
Postponing doesn't mark the event as completed or permanently remove it.
When its normal conditions are met again on another day, the story can return.
No rushing. No pressure.
Your valley, your pace.

[b]🎭 Multiple Events? You Choose![/b]
Sometimes several events are waiting in the same location.
Normally, Stardew Valley decides which eligible event starts first.
Event Pace can bring those compatible events together in one simple selection menu.
You can:
• Choose which events to experience now.
• Select multiple events in the same visit.
• Postpone individual events independently.
• Let selected events continue in their natural, compatible order.
• Leave the remaining optional stories for another day.
There's no need to experience every available scene just because you've entered a location.
And when selected events finish, Event Pace respects Stardew Valley's own event conditions and progression.

[b]❤️ Important Stories Still Matter[/b]
Not every event is meant to be optional.
Some scenes are essential for story progression, introductions or other gameplay requirements.
Event Pace recognises supported required events and protects their intended progression.
When an event genuinely cannot be postponed safely, Event Pace provides an informational Continue prompt instead of offering a misleading postpone option.
This helps prevent the mod from interfering with important story sequences.
Event Pace gives you freedom where it's safe to do so, without breaking the stories Stardew Valley needs to tell.


[b]💗 Why Event Pace?[/b]
I've always loved Stardew Valley's heart events.
They're some of the most charming parts of the game, and they make the characters feel like more than just villagers following a schedule.
But I've also had those moments where I walk into a location with something completely different in mind, and suddenly I'm watching an event I wasn't planning to experience.
I didn't want to remove those moments or make them less special.
I wanted to give players a little more control over when they happen.
Sometimes I want to spend the whole day farming.
Sometimes I want to explore.
And sometimes I want to put everything aside and spend the afternoon getting to know the villagers.
That's why I created Event Pace.
A little more freedom, a little less interruption, and the same lovely stories waiting for you whenever you're ready.



📦 REQUIREMENTS & INSTALLATION
Requirements
• Stardew Valley 1.6.15 — tested
• SMAPI 4.5.2 — tested
• No other content mod required
Event Pace is a standalone SMAPI mod. Optional NPC and expansion mods are not required.
Installation
1. Install SMAPI if you haven't already.
2. Download Event Pace.
3. Extract the EventPace folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
4. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
That's it!
When Event Pace detects a compatible upcoming event, it can show the Story Sense sparkle and offer you the appropriate event choices.

💡 COMPATIBILITY / GAMEPLAY CLARIFICATION
Event Pace supports compatible vanilla scripted events while preserving Stardew Valley's original conditions and progression.
Modded Events - Compatible events from Content Patcher packs, custom NPCs and larger expansion mods can also be detected. Some unusual or custom event-start mechanisms may not be safely interceptable. Event Pace allows these events to proceed normally rather than risking broken progression.
Event Postponement - Postponement applies to the current in-game day.
An event can become available again on another day when its normal conditions are satisfied.
Postponement does not guarantee that a time-sensitive event will remain available indefinitely. Event Pace provides warnings for recognised cases where delaying may be risky. Required Events - Events that must run for safe progression are not treated as ordinary optional events.
Random Events - Some event conditions depend on random outcomes or information that cannot be safely established in advance. Story Sense may provide a general sparkle without a confirmed event count in these situations.

🤖 AI DISCLOSURE
Event Pace was conceived, designed, directed, playtested and approved by me.
Generative AI tools assisted with parts of programming, debugging, testing, performance optimisation, technical analysis and development documentation while following the gameplay and visual direction I designed and approved.
The released mod does not run an AI model during gameplay and does not require an online AI service.
Event detection, Story Sense, event selection, postponement, native event handling and compatibility behaviour are performed by systems written into the mod.
The mod does not generate dialogue, rewrite stories or create new events during gameplay.
